_note: Technical walkthrough, 60 seconds max. Same format as story-demo.json.
name: tech

items.title: One phone, no server
lines: No account, no backend: the phone is the account
items.text: A plain-JavaScript web app, installed from the browser. No server, no account: data lives in the phone's IndexedDB, and a service worker keeps it working offline.

items.title: Small AI, on the phone
lines: Whisper base · 77 MB — speech, any guest language
Opus-MT pack per language → English pivot · 130 MB each
MiniLM → 10 fixed topics · 23 MB    DistilBERT mood · 67 MB
Tesseract OCR for the guestbook photos
items.foot: Transformers.js 3.8 in the browser · packs downloaded only for booked languages
items.text: Models run in the browser with Transformers.js: Whisper for speech, one Opus-MT pack per guest language into an English pivot, MiniLM against ten fixed topics, DistilBERT for mood, Tesseract for photos. Packs are fetched only for booked languages.

items.title: Evidence
items.text: Measured with the app's own code in CI: topic accuracy ninety-three percent, mood ninety-three, FLORES-200 chrF fifty-three to sixty-five, nineteen logic tests on every push.

items.title: No internet? SMS carries it
lines: Request · answer · days · receipt · report — pasted into the other phone, understood offline
items.foot: Store-and-forward: cloud uploads made offline are queued and sent later
items.text: Every SMS ends with a code line, so a request, an answer, a receipt or a report pasted into the other phone is understood offline; uploads made offline send themselves later.

items.title: A person makes the final call
lines: Swahili output = human-written templates; the model fills counts
Below threshold → “Check” — ask a person, never guess
Chagga has no model at any size: so Swahili is the core
items.foot: Consent before contact · nothing sent without a tap · data stays on the phone
items.text: All Swahili is human-written; the model fills counts and flags what it is unsure of for a person. Chagga has no model at any size, so Swahili is the core and a person stays in the loop.
